Package ed.inf.adbs.blazedb

Class BlazeDB

java.lang.Object
ed.inf.adbs.blazedb.BlazeDB
public class BlazeDB extends Object
BlazeDB is a lightweight in-memory database system designed for processing SQL queries. It provides a command-line interface that accepts three arguments:
  • database_dir: the directory containing the database files
  • input_file: the input SQL file containing the query to be executed
  • output_file: the file where the query results will be written

The system parses the SQL query, builds an execution plan, executes the plan, and outputs the result to a file. It is designed to handle queries on a lightweight in-memory database.

  • Method Details

    • main

      public static void main(String[] args) throws FileNotFoundException
      The main entry point of the BlazeDB system. This method expects three arguments in the command line: the database directory, the input SQL file, and the output file. It initializes the database, parses the SQL query, builds the query execution plan, and executes it.
      Parameters:
      args - the command-line arguments containing the database directory, input SQL file, and output file
      Throws:
      FileNotFoundException - if the input file is not found

    • parseSQLFromFilename

      public static net.sf.jsqlparser.statement.Statement parseSQLFromFilename(String filename)
      Parses the SQL statement from a file and returns a JSQLParser Statement object.

      This method uses the JSQLParser library to parse the contents of the provided SQL file into a Statement object. The statement is later processed to extract the query details.

      Parameters:
      filename - the path to the file containing the SQL query
      Returns:
      the parsed Statement object, or null if an error occurs

    • execute

      public static void execute(Operator root, String outputFile)
      Executes the provided query plan by repeatedly calling getNextTuple() on the root operator of the query plan tree. The resulting tuples are written to the specified output file.

      This method retrieves the result tuples generated by the operator tree and writes them in CSV format to the output file. It also prints the result as a formatted table to the console.

      Parameters:
      root - the root operator of the query plan (assumed to be non-null)
      outputFile - the name of the file where the results will be written

    • formatAsTable

      public static String formatAsTable(List<List<String>> rows)
      Formats a list of rows into a human-readable table format.

      This method takes a list of rows, where each row is a list of strings representing the columns, and returns a formatted string where the rows are aligned in a table-like structure, with columns aligned based on the maximum width of the values in each column.

      Parameters:
      rows - the list of rows to be formatted
      Returns:
      a formatted table as a string
